name: DC Hub
description: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection. Its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets. 94 tools covering grid, energy prices, interconnection queues, fiber, and site analysis. Remote MCP at https://dchub.cloud/mcp — free to start.

installation.command: Connect any MCP client to https://dchub.cloud/mcp (Streamable HTTP). Free to start: https://dchub.cloud/connect?utm_source=bgizdov-awesome-mcp-servers&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=directories

examples: Get market DCPI rank for a metro

requirements.other: HTTPS MCP client; free key optional to start

features: Data Center Power Index (DCPI) across 300+ markets
94 MCP tools for grid, energy, fiber, and site selection
Remote Streamable HTTP — no local install required
